title: niphobolus angustatus
intro: Niphobolus angustatus, commonly known as Chinese club moss, is a type of plant in the family Lycopodiaceae, which belongs to a group of ancient, vascular plants. The health benefits of Niphobolus angustatus include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve respiratory function, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, it is used to treat a range of conditions, including hypertension, bronchitis, and digestive issues, due to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Niphobolus angustatus include lignans, triterpenoids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
